text: Line of Regard: Ger. Blicklinie ; Fr. ligne de regard (Helmholtz, Physiol . Optik , Fr. trans., 599); Ital. linea di mira . The straight line connecting the point of regard or fixation point with the centre of rotation of the eye. See Fig. 7 under VISION. Literature : HELMHOLTZ, Physiol. Optik (2nd ed.), 91, 617, 679; SANFORD, Course in Exper. Psychol., 119, and expts. 176, 177, 219; WUNDT, Physiol. Psychol. (4th ed.), ii. 99, 121; AUBERT, Physiol. Optik, 419, 646; HERING, in Hermann's Handb. d. Physiol., III. i. 441. See LINE OF VISION. ( E.B.T. )
